headline: Anthropic filing says Claude may soon hit its self-acceleration threshold
body: Anthropic's amended IPO filing said Claude may 'imminently' reach the Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI-driven acceleration of AI research, and disclosed about $895 billion in compute commitments. That pushed both Capability Velocity and Power Concentration up. Marvell's roughly $115 billion all-stock deal for Lumentum added more to Power Concentration, which rose 0.32 on the day, the largest factor move. Abu Dhabi signed four deals with OpenAI, including machine-readable government rules, lifting AI Autonomy. Meituan's 1.6-trillion-parameter LongCat-2.5, trained on Chinese chips, and Germany's 'KI-Nation 2030' plan added to Capability Velocity, while SUSE's 10% job cuts, citing AI, nudged Shared Prosperity down. Zookeeper, Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator rose. Horizon Balance fell to -10.07 from -9.98.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.3, mostly from Marvell's Lumentum deal (+0.12) and Anthropic's RSP filing (+0.11), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). Zookeeper +0.2, mostly from the Abu Dhabi-OpenAI deals (+0.10) and Anthropic's RSP filing (+0.08), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.10). Benevolent Dictator +0.2, mostly from Marvell's Lumentum deal (+0.10) and the Abu Dhabi-OpenAI deals (+0.10).
coming_up: India TRAI AI-governance comments due 27 Nov
